title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 30: the promise of return, the word that is near, and the call to choose life.

questions.text: If Israel returns to Yahweh while among the nations, what will Yahweh then do?
questions.explanation: If they return and obey his voice, Yahweh will release them from captivity, have compassion on them, and gather them from all the peoples where he scattered them.

answers.text: Gather them from all the peoples where he scattered them
Leave them among the nations for all generations
Give them a new king from the land of Egypt
Send them back into the wilderness for forty years

questions.text: From how far away does Yahweh promise to gather their outcasts?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that if their outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh will gather them.

answers.text: From the deepest depths of the sea
From beyond the river Euphrates
From the uttermost parts of the heavens
From the caves of the mountains

questions.text: What will Yahweh circumcise, so that they love him with all their heart and soul?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Yahweh will circumcise their heart and the heart of their offspring, to love him with all their heart and soul.

answers.text: Their ears and the ears of their children
Their heart and the heart of their offspring
Their lips and the lips of their elders
Their hands and the hands of their servants

questions.text: On whom will Yahweh put all these curses?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says Yahweh will put all these curses on their enemies and on those who hate them and persecuted them.

answers.text: On the priests who failed them
On the animals of the field
On the land of Canaan
On their enemies and those who hate them

questions.text: How is the commandment given "today" described in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says this commandment "is not too hard for you or too distant."

answers.text: Too heavy for anyone to carry
Not too hard for them or too distant
Hidden until the latter days
Only for the priests to understand

questions.text: Because the commandment is not in heaven, which question do they not need to ask?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says it is not in heaven, that they should say, "Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us?"

answers.text: "Who will go up for us to heaven and bring it to us?"
"Who will dig for it in the earth?"
"Who will ask the prophets for it?"
"Who will buy it from the nations?"

questions.text: Where is the word, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the word is very near to them, in their mouth and in their heart, that they may do it.

answers.text: In the ark of the covenant
On tablets in the tent
In their mouth and in their heart
On the top of the mountain

questions.text: What has been set before them today, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: "I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil."

answers.text: Gold and silver, and bronze and iron
Bread and wine, and oil and honey
Peace and rest, and war and famine
Life and prosperity, and death and evil

questions.text: Whom does the speaker call to witness against them today?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: "I call heaven and earth to witness against you today."

answers.text: Heaven and earth
The sun and the moon
The elders and the priests
The nations around them

questions.text: What are they urged to choose, so that they and their descendants may live?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: "Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants."

answers.text: A king
Life
A new land
Peace with the nations
